2608.21224.title: Ontology-supported AI Model and Dataset Management
2608.21224.paper_summary: Recently, there has been a great deal of research into improving AI methods and their application. The main focus is on tracking progress, enabling transparent comparisons, and fostering a more profound understanding of AI. In that process, different organizations generate and use plenty of assets that need to be tracked, traced and managed. Moreover, it is important to discover assets relevant for the task at hand. This paper presents research aiming to contribute to answering the question of what is required to exchange and manage AI models and related assets effectively without semantic gaps in an industrial context. We introduce a platform for AI model exchange, which facilitates the usage, exchange, and analysis of AI models and datasets. The platform incorporates an ontology that can foster a more profound common understanding of what is required in these tasks and help tackle the issues mentioned above. Finally, we elucidate the utility of the platform through the illustration of a use case in the context of real-time critical systems.
2608.21224.paper_summary_zh: 最近，對於改進人工智慧方法及其應用的研究有了大量進展。<lb/>主要焦點在於追蹤進展、實現透明的比較，以及促進對人工智慧的更深入理解。<lb/>在這個過程中，不同的組織產生並使用大量需要被追蹤、追溯和管理的資產。<lb/>此外，發現與當前任務相關的資產也非常重要。<lb/>本文提出的研究旨在回答在工業背景下，如何有效地交換和管理人工智慧模型及相關資產而不產生語義差距的問題。<lb/>我們介紹了一個人工智慧模型交換平台，該平台促進了人工智慧模型和數據集的使用、交換和分析。<lb/>該平台包含一個本體，能夠促進對這些任務所需內容的更深入的共同理解，並幫助解決上述問題。<lb/>最後，我們通過在實時關鍵系統背景下的使用案例來闡明該平台的實用性。
